rows.grounds: instrumental of jalabījāmṛta with enclitic eva; internal sandhi amṛtena + eva
compound of tat, bhasma, and plāvana; accusative singular neuter object
third-person singular active present indicative of root car

items.question: What act must be performed upon the ash after it has been dried by fire?
items.inference: After fire-drying, the ash is washed with water-bija nectar.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of jalabīja is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: After drying by fire, wash that ash with the nectar of the water-bīja.
